title: finding(scripts): check-changeset-no-major prints that a narrowing "ships minor" during the launch window, while in pre mode it accepts major; two PRs landed the same class at minor and at major
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site: a gate's verdict text that disagrees with what the gate accepts.** reach: read from source on `main`, and seen on two PRs of one seat on one day. Escalated by PR #22364's contract review (`6071079626` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#9272). Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021), `session_01WkL6Eijt432S1Y7ekb6ovQ`. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## Read from source
- `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` near `:1464` (docblock) and `:1502` (the printed line) say that a `no (narrowing)` arm is "a BREAKING change; during the launch window it ships `minor`".
- With `.changeset/pre.json` in `pre` mode (tag `next`, since objectstack-ai/objectstack#22080), the same script skips its no-major guard: "`major` bumps are the expected product of an RC window".
- So, in one run, the gate accepts `major` and tells the author the grade is `minor`.

## Seen on `main` the same day
- PR #22357 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22345) graded an accept-set narrowing `minor` with a BREAKING banner, following the printed line.
- PR #22364 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#9272) graded the same class `major`, following its card's triage line ("after #22080 it is graded `major`").
- Both pass. Under #22080's single `major` marker the versions they produce are the same (`18.0.0-next.*`), so nothing ships wrong. What is missing is one stated convention for the pre-mode window, and the gate's text naming it.

## Direction (for triage)
Choose the pre-mode grade for a narrowing, and make the gate's arm line say it while `pre.json` is in `pre` mode. Text only, unless the ruling also wants the level axis to check it.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` 「check-changeset-no-major pre mode narrowing ships minor launch window major grade convention」 gave 5 hits: objectstack-ai/objectstack#22080, #8411, #19008, #16421 and #7005, all closed. #19008 is the closest: the same gate's headline mislabelled a narrowing. None is this.

Dedupe words: check-changeset-no-major ships minor pre mode · narrowing grade pre mode major minor · launch window arm line stale
